text:
emma: quick PSA — running through the new sample app onboarding and noticed SDKs disagree on error shapes. small but painful for customers during quickstarts.
leo: can you paste an example? is it runtime vs typed exceptions or just fields missing?
emma: sure. python raises `RedwoodError(code='quota_exceeded', message='quota exceeded')` (typed class). js returns `Error: Quota exceeded` with `err.code = 'quota_exceeded'` on the object (no class). makes catch patterns different.
maya: ugh. that explains why our Node sample app just logs and exits instead of retrying. we have retry middleware that checks `instanceof RedwoodError` in examples. :grimacing:
sanjay: related: auth failures also inconsistent — python client throws `AuthError` for 401/403, but JS surfaces 401 as `UnauthorizedError` without `.retryable = false` flag. We should standardize `retryable` and `status_code` on typed exceptions.
ana: (typo: ana) I think we decided in last SDK sync that every SDK must expose a stable error contract: `name`, `code`, `status`, `retryable`, `hint` — and a language-idiomatic class where possible. Did that spec not land?
ana: I dug up notes from 2025-11 sync, it's a draft in google drive but not enforced. link: https://redwood.internal/sdks/error-contract-draft
leo: if we enforce, we need a migration plan. many customers catch `Error` in JS. We should provide a shim: set `error.name = 'RedwoodError'` and attach typed props so both `instanceof` and property checks work.
maya: +1 for shim. also sample apps should show canonical error handling snippet. propose we add a short section to each quickstart (JS/Python/Go) demonstrating: retry vs failfast, inspect `err.code`, use `err.hint` for user-friendly messages.
ci-bot: deploy-check: sample-apps repo tests failed 3/3 due to flaky assertion on error message text (timed out). See job 12489
emma: thanks CI. action items: 1) spec -> finalize and post in sdk-specs, 2) implement shim in JS SDK to attach typed props, 3) update sample apps with canonical error handling, 4) run e2e to verify onboarding. volunteers?
ana: I can own spec PR and a tiny lint rule to assert presence of required fields in SDK responses.
leo: I can do JS shim and add tests.
sanjay: I'll update Node and Python quickstarts with examples and a note about auth retry semantics (401/403 differences).
maya: small UX ask: make the `hint` human-readable and short. sample app should use hint for end-user popup, not raw message.
emma: great. timeline? we should get a patch in before next release cut (2 weeks).
leo: will aim for a PR this week for shim + tests. assigning myself.
nana: will open spec PR today and ping in #eng-sdks once ready.
ci-bot: reminder: include changelog entry when landing error-contract changes.
maya: thanks y'all. will follow up on sample app PRs and add a regression test for onboarding flow that asserts retry behavior for 429 and failfast for 401.
emma: :thumbsup: closing loop — will drop a short note in the onboarding checklist and mark the ticket: INT-4872.
